data.title: What happened before the pain
data.goal: Describe a body part, a starting time and an observed change without inventing a diagnosis.

data.situation:
Lin followed the nurse from the window chair into a room on the right. A desk faced the door, and a simple body diagram hung beside it. She sat down with the form from reception. When the nurse asked what had brought her in, Lin touched her knee. She had fallen at the sports centre the day before. The injury still bothered her, especially when she got up from a chair. She wanted it checked before returning to her usual activities. Nurse: How long has your knee been hurting?
Lin: My knee has hurt since yesterday.
Nurse: What happened?
Lin: It started when I fell yesterday. I received first aid at the sports centre.
Nurse: Does anything make the pain worse?
Lin: The pain is worse when I stand up.
Nurse: Let me write that down. Was the fall at the sports centre?
Lin: Yes. That is where I was helped. On a small timeline card, the nurse wrote the symptom and the time of the fall. She added the place below them and turned the card towards Lin. Lin checked the date, then pointed to the words “standing up”. The nurse kept that detail beside the description of the pain before placing the card in the folder on the right of the desk.

readingBlocks.en: Lin followed the nurse from the window chair into a room on the right. A desk faced the door, and a simple body diagram hung beside it. She sat down with the form from reception. When the nurse asked what had brought her in, Lin touched her knee. She had fallen at the sports centre the day before. The injury still bothered her, especially when she got up from a chair. She wanted it checked before returning to her usual activities.
readingBlocks.zh: 林跟着护士从窗边候诊椅走进右侧房间。桌子正对着门，旁边挂着简单的人体图。她拿着接待处给的表坐下。护士问她为什么来时，林碰了碰膝盖。前一天，她在运动中心跌倒了。伤处仍让她难受，尤其从椅子上起身时。恢复平常活动之前，她想先让人检查。

readingBlocks.en:
Nurse: How long has your knee been hurting?
Lin: My knee has hurt since yesterday.
Nurse: What happened?
Lin: It started when I fell yesterday. I received first aid at the sports centre.
Nurse: Does anything make the pain worse?
Lin: The pain is worse when I stand up.
Nurse: Let me write that down. Was the fall at the sports centre?
Lin: Yes. That is where I was helped.
readingBlocks.zh:
护士：膝盖疼了多久？
林：我的膝盖从昨天起一直疼。
护士：发生了什么？
林：我昨天跌倒时开始疼的，在运动中心接受了急救。
护士：什么情况下会更疼？
林：站起来的时候更疼。
护士：让我记下来。是在运动中心跌倒的吗？
林：对，我也是在那里得到帮助的。

readingBlocks.en: On a small timeline card, the nurse wrote the symptom and the time of the fall. She added the place below them and turned the card towards Lin. Lin checked the date, then pointed to the words “standing up”. The nurse kept that detail beside the description of the pain before placing the card in the folder on the right of the desk.
readingBlocks.zh: 护士在小时间卡上写下症状与跌倒的时间，在下方加上地点，把卡转向林。林核对日期，又指了指“站起来”几个字。护士把这个细节留在疼痛描述旁，然后将卡放进桌子右侧的文件夹。

data.zhSupport: 桌旁人体图 → 桌面时间卡 → 事实描述文件夹。先说明事实，再核对不清楚的信息。
data.easySummary: Lin describes when her knee started hurting and what makes it worse. The nurse writes down the details.
data.easySummaryZh: 林说明膝盖何时开始疼，以及什么情况下更疼；护士记下这些细节。

glossary.note: 可向医护描述的身体或心理变化；说出症状不等于自己已确定病因。
glossary.example: The nurse asked when the symptom started.
glossary.exampleZh: 护士问症状是什么时候开始的。

glossary.note: 本课指跌倒造成的身体损伤；疼痛是描述，不能由疼痛自行推断某种确诊结果。
glossary.example: I have a knee injury after a fall.

glossary.note: 受伤或突发不适后给予的初步紧急帮助；本课报告此前获得的帮助，不教授操作。
glossary.example: I received first aid at the sports centre.
glossary.exampleZh: 我在运动中心接受了急救。

glossary.note: 描述身体部位与开始时间；has hurt在这里说明持续到现在的情况。
glossary.example: My knee has hurt since yesterday.
glossary.exampleZh: 我的膝盖从昨天起一直疼。
matchTexts: My knee has hurt since yesterday.

glossary.note: 连接症状与发生经过；提供所知事实，不直接命名病因。
glossary.example: It started when I fell yesterday.
glossary.exampleZh: 它是在我昨天跌倒的时候开始的。
matchTexts: It started when I fell yesterday.

glossary.note: 描述变化条件，让医护判断；worse是比较，不说明损伤类型。
glossary.example: The pain is worse when I stand up.
glossary.exampleZh: 我站起来的时候疼痛会更严重。
matchTexts: The pain is worse when I stand up.

retrievalPrompts.cue: Your knee began to hurt yesterday and still hurts. Tell the nurse the body part and the starting time.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你的膝盖昨天开始疼，现在仍疼。向护士说明部位与开始时间。
acceptableAnswers: My knee has hurt since yesterday.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Connect the current pain to its starting point.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说明持续到现在；补上开始时间。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The pain began when you fell yesterday. Explain the event and mention the earlier help at the sports centre.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 疼痛是在昨天跌倒时开始的；说明经过，并提到运动中心此前给予的急救。
acceptableAnswers: It started when I fell yesterday. I received first aid at the sports centre.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Report the event and the earlier help without adding a diagnosis.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说明发生经过；说明此前帮助，不添加诊断。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Standing up makes the pain greater. Explain this observed change.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 站起来时疼痛更严重。说明这一观察到的变化。
acceptableAnswers: The pain is worse when I stand up.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the condition that changes the pain.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说出疼痛变化；说明变化条件。

transferPrompt.cue: At a different visit, your throat began to hurt on Monday and still hurts. Describe the body part and duration.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 另一次就诊：你的喉咙从周一起一直疼。说明部位和持续时间。
acceptableAnswers: My throat has hurt since Monday.
transferPrompt.feedback: Change the body part and time; do not reuse the fall as a cause.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 替换部位和时间；不要沿用跌倒经过。
